\# HealthAxis



> Full-Stack Healthcare Management and Appointment Platform built using \*\*ASP.NET Core Web API\*\*, \*\*Angular\*\*, \*\*Blazor WebAssembly\*\*, \*\*SQL Server\*\*, \*\*RabbitMQ\*\*, \*\*MassTransit\*\*, \*\*AWS Elastic Beanstalk\*\*, and \*\*Jenkins CI/CD\*\*.



\*\*\*



\# Quick Start



```powershell

git clone https://github.com/bootcamp-hackerearth/UST-Live-01.git



cd UST-Live-01



git checkout Feature/Sprint5\_Pod4\_NandanaLinson



dotnet restore .\\HealthAxis.Api\\HealthAxis.Api.csproj



powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\\build-frontends.ps1



dotnet run --project .\\HealthAxis.Api\\HealthAxis.Api.csproj

```



\*\*\*



\# Overview



HealthAxis is a role-based healthcare management system that centralizes patient care, appointments, health records, doctor operations, and administrative workflows.



The platform consists of:



\* Angular Patient and Doctor Portal

\* Blazor WebAssembly Admin Portal

\* ASP.NET Core Web API Backend

\* SQL Server Database

\* ASP.NET Identity Authentication

\* JWT Authorization

\* RabbitMQ Messaging

\* Jenkins CI/CD Automation

\* AWS Elastic Beanstalk Deployment



\*\*\*



\# Problem Statement



Healthcare operations are often scattered across disconnected tools and workflows.



Common challenges include:



\* Managing patient appointments efficiently

\* Maintaining structured health records

\* Coordinating doctor schedules

\* Providing secure access for different user roles

\* Managing healthcare operations from a centralized dashboard

\* Deploying and maintaining the system reliably



HealthAxis addresses these challenges through a unified healthcare platform.



\*\*\*



\# Solution



HealthAxis provides three dedicated user experiences:



\### Patient Portal



\* Appointment booking

\* Appointment tracking

\* Health record access

\* Profile management



\### Doctor Portal



\* Appointment management

\* Patient consultation workflow

\* Health record creation

\* Profile management



\### Admin Portal



\* Dashboard

\* Doctor management

\* Patient management

\* Appointment administration

\* Operational monitoring



All functionality is powered by a centralized ASP.NET Core backend and hosted through a single deployment.

\# Known Limitations



\* Distributed cache configuration depends on deployment environment.

\* RabbitMQ connectivity requires proper network configuration.

\* Large-scale deployments may require dedicated background workers.

\* Additional monitoring dashboards can improve observability.
